facts.value: During motion state 9, first runs ground-support processing with itDosei_80282074 as the support-loss callback. It then independently tests xDD8, whose phase-2 value is produced by the animation callback when the angular remainder becomes nonpositive. At phase 2 it saves the current animation frame, initializes walking state 1, and restores the frame. Other phase values skip this handoff. The phase test is not guarded by the ground helper's outcome; floor-alignment processing follows and the callback always returns false.
